docTitle: Srikanth Yadugani - Senior Testing Lead - PETADATA
name: SRIKANTH YADUGANI
title: ==SENIOR TESTING LEAD==  |  AUTOMATION & DATA VALIDATION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Senior Testing Lead== with 15+ years of QA experience in financial services and retirement software, spanning automation, functional testing, data checks and release delivery. Enhanced Java/Selenium frameworks and utilities for SQL-backed report validation, PDF comparison, file transfers and downloads, and XML and pipe-delimited data checks. Brings hands-on API testing, CI pipeline execution, test estimation and QA mentoring.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Led QA work across the STLC, translating requirements into test scenarios, test cases, effort estimates and execution plans.
Automated sprint requirements with Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD and incorporated completed scripts into weekly regression.
Developed and enhanced utilities for plan-health report validation, PDF comparison, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter; used SQL to validate report data.
Extended automation frameworks for PDF validation, FTP file transfer and file downloads to support project-specific testing.
Validated database and data files using SQL Server Management Studio and PowerSelect, including XML and pipe-delimited formats.
Executed and scheduled regression via GitLab/GitHub Pipelines, Jenkins jobs, Windows Task Scheduler and GitLab Runner infrastructure.
Coordinated deployment and release activities, identified delivery risks, reviewed test estimates and mentored QA colleagues.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
bullets: Worked on a communications platform integrating data and delivering retirement and financial documents through print, email and online channels.
Project environment included SQL, Postman, FTP, PDFBox, Selenium, Java, Cucumber and Maven.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Executed multi-environment testing and regression for retirement recordkeeping applications and developed Selenium scripts for eCompliance.
